text: {"lessons":["My account grew while I mostly held, so I should not assume frequent trading is necessary to make progress.","Selling some appreciated Stock B and Stock E and buying other stocks changed my allocation; I should check that any such trades serve a deliberate diversification plan, not just lock in gains or chase recent moves.","One month’s result cannot show whether my trades were wise; I should judge decisions by my risk plan over time and keep losses in perspective without letting loss aversion drive impulsive choices."]}
